scope: Native package enumeration callbacks and SYSTEM:MAP-FOREACH suspension in dual builds; not all JavaScript callbacks or a thread API.

implementation.package: Generator alternatives attached to all three native package enumeration functions. Registered wrappers retain alternatives and arity checks. Each inspected symbol yields a checkpoint, including non-exported and shadowed entries. Callback results are discarded and enumeration returns one NIL value.
implementation.map: Lisp TAGBODY loop advances Map.entries()/next(), then FUNCALL delegates to callback alternatives. Ordinary callbacks work as before, normal completion returns NIL. Early bootstrap file cannot use DO/LOOP macros.

kernel.scope: Existing11 plus callback suspension/visibility/duplicate inheritance/shadowing/values and checkpoint-bounded private-symbol traversal/interruption cleanup.
